description: Two DIFFERENT java.util.Locale keys that render as the SAME BCP 47 language tag. Locale.forLanguageTag("no-NO-x-lvariant-NY") produces the legacy no_NO_NY locale, whose toLanguageTag() is "nn-NO" -- exactly what the second filename parses to -- while the two Locale objects are not equal (language `no` with variant `NY` versus language `nn`). The per-file duplicate check inside loadFromDirectory keys on Locale and therefore lets both through; only unmodifiableLocaleMapInLanguageTagOrder's rendered-tag set catches it. AUDIT NOTE: the disposition suggested ja-JP-x-lvariant-JP / ja-JP-u-ca-japanese, which does NOT collide on JDK 21 -- the lvariant form renders as ja-JP-u-ca-japanese-x-lvariant-JP, keeping the private-use suffix. Verified by probe before authoring. loadOnly because the directory cannot load at all.
